text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager alert: runtime-prod cluster — repeated CrashLoopBackOff for containers in gpu-pool-7 (runtime-engine). Error rate spike at 14:12 UTC. Paging oncall.

alice.chen: On it. I see a bunch of OOM + segfault traces in the runtime container logs. Rolling failures across 3 pods on node-12/13/14. Last restart reason: signal SIGSEGV.

ben.kapoor: Noted. Likely in fused attention kernel path (we've seen similar after recent quantized-kernel merge). Any stack traces?

alice.chen: Pasting relevant tail of kubectl logs from pod runtime-ff7b:
```
2026-03-15T14:11:52Z runtime ERROR: cuda: driver not responding
2026-03-15T14:11:52Z runtime FATAL: segfault at 0x0 in fused_attention_kernel.cu:47
Backtrace:
  #0 0x7f3c11a2 in fused_attention::dispatch()
  #1 0x7f3bfe12 in runtime::forward()
  #2 0x55a1b3c4 in main
```

alice.chen: Also seeing repeated "failed to allocate kv cache" lines before crash; memory pressure seems high.

maria.torres: Customer impact check: how many requests affected and which customers? Support triage?

eric.zhao: Support reports increased 5xx for a handful of enterprise tenants — tickets INC-4123, INC-4124, INC-4126. Preliminary: 4 customers impacted, mostly chat endpoints timing out and then container restart.

ben.kapoor: Immediate mitigation options:
- roll back engine image to v3.1.2 (previous stable) — safest
- set TRT_DISABLE_FUSED_KERNELS=1 to force unfused kernels (performance hit but avoids fused kernel crash)
- scale down pool to 0 and replace pods on fresh nodes

kevin.patel: I'll cordon node-12 and drain it to stop noisy restarts. Doing: `kubectl cordon node-12 && kubectl drain node-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` — will move affected pods off.

alice.chen: Trying TRT_DISABLE_FUSED_KERNELS env toggle on a single pod as test. Patch config and restart one pod.

incident-bot: Deploy request created by alice.chen: deploy/runtime-engine -> set env TRT_DISABLE_FUSED_KERNELS=1  (canary = 1 pod)

ben.kapoor: If test pod stabilizes, do a staged rollout across pool. If it still segfaults, roll back to engine:v3.1.2.

alice.chen: Test pod up for 90s, no segfaults yet. Logs show kernel fallback path enabled. CPU latency higher but stable: requests are succeeding.

maria.torres: Good — start canary to 25% of pool. Also add fallback routing rule to move sensitive tenants to dedicated pool if errors > 5%.

eric.zhao: Notifying impacted customers: sending update to INC-4123/4124/4126 that we're mitigating and will post ETA in 15m. Ticket notes: "We observed container restarts; temporary degraded latency expected." :pray:

kevin.patel: Node-12 drained. Node-13showed nvlink errors; I'm provisioning replacement host and cordoning as precaution.

alice.chen: Rolling update across gpu-pool-7: setting TRT_DISABLE_FUSED_KERNELS=1 on all runtime-engine pods. Patch applied. Monitoring.

incident-bot: Metric alert suppressed (muted) by alice.chen for 10m while rollout stabilizes.

ben.kapoor: Quick note — this indicates fused-kernel path introduced a null-deref when mixed with quantized KV cache under memory pressure. We'll queue a revert patch for the fused merge and add an address sanitizer run on CI for fused kernels.

maria.torres: Ops decision: keep TRT_DISABLE_FUSED_KERNELS=1 as default for gpu-pool-7 until stable hotfix is deployed. Cost/perf impact communicated to product.

alice.chen: After full rollout, error rate dropped from 18% to 0.4% over 6 minutes. Pod restarts stopped. Current 5xx are nominal.

eric.zhao: Sent customer updates: INC-4123/4124/4126 — customers acknowledged, asked for postmortem. Will track.

kevin.patel: Replaced node-13. Marking node-12/13 unsched as temporary. Will put them back after soak.

sam.lee: Jumping in for handoff in 20m — will own next 8hr window. Anything unresolved I should be aware of?

alice.chen: Main TODOs for handoff:
- runtime/ben: patch revert + regression test for fused kernel
- infra/kevin: monitor replacement nodes and nvlink errors
- support/eric: collect all affected tenant logs + request ids
- product/maria: communicate perf impact to customers

sam.lee: Copy. I will keep TRT_DISABLE_FUSED_KERNELS=1 in the pool config and watch for regressions. Ping me @sam.lee for any regression alerts.

ben.kapoor: Opening a follow-up bug: RUNTIME-8793 (fused-kernel null deref under quantized KV) with repro steps and stack traces. Will draft a hotfix PR and target fast-track review.

incident-bot: Incident recorded: incident/2026-03-15-runtime-fusedkernel-crashloop with severity P2. Links: runbook, perf dashboard, support tickets.

maria.torres: Thanks team. After hotfix and postmortem, we'll schedule a small perf experiment to re-enable fused kernels behind a flag.

alice.chen: Closing this thread for active paging. Will update incident doc with timeline and attach logs. :thumbsup:
